Charcoal and green masks

Activated charcoal is popular with oily and combination skin because it draws dirt and impurities out of the pores. Deyga's Charcoal Detox Face Mask (£15.99) helps control excess oil for a clear, refreshed look. Vilvah's Charcoal Face Mask (£12.99) pairs charcoal with aloe vera and tea tree hydrosol for a brighter-looking, more even tone.
